['Select substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name, canonical_smiles', 'From metabolism', 'Join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id', 'Join compound_structures on compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', 'Join molecule_dictionary as substrate on compound_records.molregno = substrate.molregno', 'Join molecule_dictionary as parent on metabolism.met_id = parent.molregno', 'Join target_dictionary as enzyme on substrate.tid = enzyme.tid', "Filter enzyme.pref_name = 'UGT1A1'", "Filter enzyme.target_type = 'PROTEIN'", 'Filter enzyme.tax_id = 9606', "Filter enzyme.organism = 'Homo sapiens'", "Filter enzyme.tid = (select tid from target_dictionary where pref_name = 'UGT1A1' and tax_id = 9606)", 'Limit 200', 'Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name']
